llm.summary: The skill is transparent about paid gas-data queries, but it needs review because it can spend from an AgentCash wallet and repeatedly uses an unpinned npm CLI.

dimensions.detail: Network access to the gas service and use of AgentCash are purpose-aligned, but combining mutable CLI execution with wallet-funded requests is high-impact enough to require clearer controls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requires npx and repeatedly instructs use of npx agentcash@latest, plus an unpinned global npm install, so the executed CLI can change after review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions map ordinary gas questions to paid x402 requests without requiring a fresh user confirmation, payment ceiling, or final display of endpoint and charge before each wallet-funded request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No backdoors, background workers, memory writes, privilege escalation, destructive actions, or broad local indexing were found; the only persistence-like behavior is the user-directed global CLI install.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, live and historical Base gas information through x402 endpoints, matches the documented commands and endpoint table, including disclosed per-route prices.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use only with a wallet balance you are comfortable spending from, verify the endpoint and price before each paid call, avoid automated polling, and prefer a pinned or otherwise verified AgentCash CLI version instead of @latest.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: The artifact does rely on AgentCash for its intended paid x402 workflow, but the repeated @latest npx pattern is a real supply-chain concern in a wallet/payment context.
[T09] expected: Paid requests are central to the skill and prices are disclosed, but the artifact does not require explicit per-request approval or an enforced maximum spend before using the wallet.
